response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), ratios AS (SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio FROM circuit_counts) SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
